engineering_amendments.reason: The first start exited before candidate generation because both ignored GCDH-P0 C1 checkpoint files were absent although their training summaries remained.
engineering_amendments.change: Add a preflight lineage/SHA gate and, with researcher approval, deterministically reconstruct only the missing C1 checkpoints from the locked GCDH-P0 config on physical GPU6. Continue GACR-v2 only if both reconstructed SHA256 values exactly match the historical training summaries. The cohort, model, loss, seeds, scale grid, selection rule, and reporting remain unchanged.

objective: Test one bounded change: calibration-selected residual deployment strength, while reproducing alpha=1.0 as a matched P0 baseline.

residual.loss: identical equal-weight head/tail target-vs-highest-negative hinge loss from GACR-P0

scale_selection.scope: shared across Toys, Beauty, and all training seeds
scale_selection.eligible: Recall@10 nondecrease, tail NDCG@10 nondecrease, and broad harm <=1% in every domain-seed calibration cell
scale_selection.objective: maximum mean relative overall NDCG@10 gain
scale_selection.tie_break: higher changed-user coverage, then scale closest to 1.0
scale_selection.fallback: maximum objective over all scales if none is eligible

post_run_policy: Write results only. Do not make a scientific decision or start another experiment until the researcher explicitly requests analysis.
